method: Editorial priorities inferred from implemented features, user intent, developer-owned store listings and official store guidance. Search volume, competition and conversion are not measured.

clusters.intent: Recognize road signs with a phone camera
clusters.placement: Exact core phrase in Apple keyword field, Play short description, full descriptions and recognition screenshot caption.

clusters.intent: Know the speed limit and receive warnings
clusters.placement: Apple keywords; natural descriptions and speed screenshot.
Apple keywords; Play short description; dashcam description and screenshot.

clusters.intent: Add assistance to an existing car
clusters.placement: Apple subtitle; opening description; any-car hero. Expand ADAS as informational assistance; no automatic steering or braking claim.
Apple keywords; country-supported penalty section. Always describe estimates.
Apple keywords; offline description. Country names in coverage text rather than using most of the Apple keyword budget.
App title, hero, advertising and opening copy. These express the safety purpose; conversion and query demand need measurement.

store_rules.apple: Use the separate keyword field, at most 100 characters (repository validator also conservatively limits UTF-8 bytes); comma delimiters, no spaces after commas, no unnecessary duplicates or competitor names. Promotional text does not affect search ranking. Avoid keyword stuffing in description.
store_rules.play: Use relevant phrases naturally in title, short and full descriptions. No comma-separated keyword block or unsupported features. Keep safety benefit prominent.

out_of_scope_terms.reason: Camera recognition of roadside signs is not speed-camera detection.
These promise control or safety functionality not established by this marketing work.
Do not target these searches unless the shipped functionality is separately verified.

sources.supports: Apple keyword, title, subtitle, screenshot and promotional-text guidance.
Natural feature-focused description; no excessive keyword blocks or misleading features.
Developer-owned listing uses Verkehrszeichenerkennung, Tempolimits and Dashcam; terminology evidence only.
Developer-owned listing uses dash cam, car camera, smart assistant, traffic signs and speed limit; terminology evidence only.

next_measurement: After publication is separately approved, compare search impressions, product-page views and install conversion by locale. Test safety-led versus feature-led creative; revise priority using actual query and conversion data.
